findings: a039 positively documents simulated mechanical texture testing of solid chocolate bars at Linden Grove Inner. Its title explicitly states simulation results. CSV and two JSON synopses consistently describe fracture force, tempering conditions and particle diameter with matching units and example values. The two identical JSON synopses do not establish duplicated dataset records or contradictory content.

a079 positively documents simulated refrigerated shelf-life assessment of a liquid chocolate dairy beverage at Dune Valley Inner. Its title explicitly states simulation outputs. Root description, CSV synopsis and JSON synopsis agree on microbial concentration, chamber temperature and spoilage-time variables and example values.

Facts in both reviews are documented simulated variables, not claims that physical measurements were collected. Neither record supplies an administrative ledger process. No separate empirical context is invented, and the documented product/process subject matter is not erased merely because its values are simulated.

All supplied title, complete description, keyword, publisher, distribution and available spatial fields were inspected. No temporal field is supplied for either assigned record; no spatial field is supplied for a079. Publisher names and a039's fictional location notice add no measurement evidence. No searchable answer keys, intent tags or unsupported no-answer conjunctions were found in these two records.
